1.name: Aura of the Pious
1.description: Surrounds you and your group in an aura of piousness, increasing AC by 1 (L1) to 30 (L60)

1.name: Poison Protection
1.description: Ward your target against toxins, increasing their Poison Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

1.name: Taunt
1.description: Taunt your target, causing them to focus their attacks on you. Triggers cooldown of Martial abilities.

1.name: Shoot
1.description: Shoots your target with a bow. (requires bow & arrows)

1.name: Slam
1.description: Forcefully slam your target, dealing 100% Weapon Damage plus 1 (L1) to 20 (L60) Physical Damage, and increasing your Threat by 20 (L1) to 200 (L60). Has a chance to stun from behind the target.

1.name: Weak Heal
1.description: Weakly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 6 Health.

2.name: Supplication
2.description: Cry out in prayer, increasing your Strength by 2 (L1) to 10 (L20) and Mana Regeneration by 1 for 1 minute.
2.valuesSummary: +2–10 and Mana Regeneration by 1 (L1–L20) · +2–10 Strength (L1–L20) · +1 Mana Regeneration

3.name: Cure Disease
3.description: Cures your target, removing one Disease effect.

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds.

4.name: Minor Heal
4.description: Slightly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 10 Health.

4.name: Weapon Shield
4.description: Activate to use your weapon to help shield attacks, reducing physical damage against you by 5%.

5.name: Placate
5.description: Placates an aggressive target, greatly reducing the range of their social and proximity aggro for 2 minutes. Has no effect on an already aggroed target. This ability has a slight chance to fail and cause primary and social aggro. It also has the slight chance of ending early. Limit one target.

6.name: Invisibility versus Undead
6.description: Shroud a target group member in darkness, rendering them unseen by the undead for 10 minutes. This spell has a moderate chance to end early.

7.name: Focused Concentration
7.description: Greatly sharpen your concentration, granting you a 100% chance to continue casting through incoming melee attacks for 15 seconds.

7.name: Shield Toss
7.description: Tosses a holy shield at an enemy, interrupting their spellcasting and 2 other nearby targets as the shield ricochets within 8 meters. Requires a Shield in your inventory or equipped.

8.name: Fear the Dead
8.description: Fears an undead target, causing them to run away in terror. Doing damage has a small chance to break this effect early.

8.name: Holy Fortitude
8.description: Increases the Max Hitpoints of a friendly target by 10 (L1) to 20 (L8).

8.name: Lesser Heal
8.description: Lightly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 25 Health.

8.name: Lay on Hands
8.description: Heal your target with a holy touch, restoring 99 (L1) to 3840 (L60) Health

9.name: Blind
9.description: Shroud the vision of your target, blinding them for 12 seconds.

10.name: Cure Poison
10.description: Cure your target, removing one Poison effect.

10.name: Restorative Smite
10.description: Smite your target with holy energy, dealing 150% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 20 (L60) Holy Damage, 1 (L1) to 20 (L60) Physical Damage, and increasing your Threat against them by 30 (L1) to 300 (L60). Additionally, this ability consumes one charge of Fulfillment to restore 1 (L1) to 40 (L60) Health to your group. This ability has a chance to strike your target a second time (L50).
10.valuesSummary: 150% weapon dmg · 1–20 Holy dmg (L1–L60) · 1–20 Physical dmg (L1–L60)

11.name: Disease Protection
11.description: Ward your target against sickness, increasing their Disease Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

12.name: Ancient Guardian
12.description: Summons a holy, ancient guardian to assist you in battle. The ancient guardian heals you and other friendly targets. Persists for 30 seconds, or until death of pet or master.

12.name: Ward the Dead
12.description: Wards an undead target with holy energy for 30 points of Holy Damage.

13.name: Corruption Protection
13.description: Ward your target against subversion, increasing their Corruption Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

14.name: Snare the Dead
14.description: Holy energy erupts from the ground and cling to your target's feet, decreasing their Movement Speed by 35% for 30 seconds.

15.name: Unleash the Light
15.description: Unleash blinding holy light, mesmerizing up to 10 targets in ta frontal cone for 6 seconds.

16.name: Heal
16.description: Moderately heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 70 Health.

16.name: Mark of the Crusader
16.description: Apply a Mark of the Crusader on an enemy target, which has a high chance of healing friendly targets who attack the marked target for 1 (L1) to 6 (L60) Health, and removing the enemy target's Damage Shield. Lasts 30 seconds. Only Primary Hand and Ranged Attacks can proc the Mark of the Crusader healing.

17.name: Deflect
17.description: Deflect magical attacks, reducing incoming Magic Damage dealt to you by 40% for 30 seconds.

effects.stat: incoming Magic Damage dealt to you

18.name: Root
18.description: Roots emerge from the ground and cling to your target's feet, applying an immobilize effect for 30 seconds. This effect has a change to be removed by Damage or end early. Limit one.

19.name: Appease
19.description: Appease your target, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early.

20.name: Cleanse Diseases
20.description: Cleanse your target, removing two Disease effects.

20.name: Cleanse Poisons
20.description: Cleanse your target, removing two Poison effects.

20.name: Divine Aegis
20.description: Surround yourself with a divine aegis, granting you immunity to all incoming damage for 15 seconds. This spell can be used while stunned, incapacitated, or feared. This spell inflicts Exhausted Soul upon expiration, preventing the application of immunity effects for 30 seconds.

20.name: Holy Focus
20.description: Increases the maximum Health of a friendly target by 50 for 30 minutes.

21.name: Blessing of Sanctuary
21.description: Bless your group with sanctuary, reducing all damage received by 20% for 20 seconds. This spell inflicts Recently Exhausted upon expiration, preventing reapplication of this effect for 20 minutes.

24.name: Beset the Dead
24.description: Wards off an undead target with holy energy for 90 points of Holy Damage.

24.name: Stun
24.description: Shocks your target, applying a Stun for 4 seconds.

28.name: Holy Valor
28.description: Increases the maximum health of a friendly target by 125 for 30 minutes.

29.name: Greater Heal
29.description: Greatly heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 325 Health.

30.name: Supplication II
30.description: Cry out in prayer, increasing your Strength by 15 (L20) to 25 (L40) and Mana Regeneration by 2 for 1 minute.
30.valuesSummary: +15–25 and Mana Regeneration by 2 (L20–L40) · +15–25 Strength (L20–L40) · +2 Mana Regeneration

32.name: Conciliate
32.description: Conciliate your target, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early.

36.name: Conciliate the Masses
36.description: Conciliate your target, reducing their Body Aggro Radius for 4 minutes.

36.name: Rebuff the Dead
36.description: Rebuff a target undead with a blast of energy, dealing 150 Holy Damage.

40.name: Holy Resilience
40.description: Bestow holy resilience upon your target, increasing their maximum Health by 175 for 1 hour.

44.name: Resuscitation
44.description: Resuscitate a target corpse, restoring 35% experience. This spell inflicts Resurrection Illness on the target, reducing all of their stats for 3 minutes.

44.name: Corruption Resistance
44.description: Greatly ward your target against subversion, increasing their Corruption Resistance by 15 for 1 hour.

44.name: Disease Resistance
44.description: Greatly ward your target against subversion, increasing their Disease Resistance by 15 for 1 hour.

44.name: Poison Resistance
44.description: Greatly ward your target against toxins, increasing their Poison Resistance by 15 for 1 hour.

48.name: Beleaguer the Dead
48.description: Beleaguer a target undead with a blast of energy, dealing 245 Holy Damage.

50.name: Exceptional Heal
50.description: Exceptionally heals the wounds of a friendly target, healing them for 600 Health.

50.name: Supplication III
50.description: Cry out in prayer, increasing your Strength by 30 (L40) to 40 (L60) and Mana Regeneration by 3 for 1 minute.
50.valuesSummary: +30–40 and Mana Regeneration by 3 (L40–L60) · +30–40 Strength (L40–L60) · +3 Mana Regeneration

51.name: Propitiate
51.description: Propitiate your target, reducing their Aggro Radius for 5 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early.

52.name: Holy Resolve
52.description: Bestow holy resolve upon your target, increasing their maximum Health by 250 for 1 hour.

55.name: Abolish Magic
55.description: Abolish magic from your target, removing two harmful effects.

56.name: Propitiate the Masses
56.description: Propitiate your target, reducing their Body Aggro Radius for 5 minutes.

56.name: Reawaken
56.description: Reawaken a target corpse, restoring 50% experience. This spell inflicts Resurrection Illness on the target, reducing all of their stats for 3 minutes.

60.name: Assail the Dead
60.description: Assail a target undead with a blast of energy, dealing 525 Holy Damage.

60.name: Divine Spark
60.description: Grants Divine Spark to your target, increasing their maximum Health by 250 for 30 minutes.

60.name: Supplication IV
60.description: Cry out in prayer, increasing your Strength by 50 and Mana Regeneration by 4 for 1 minute.
